rules.problem: Rolling multi-year reports repeat earlier years
rules.rule: The newest edition wins. Earlier values are kept in the revision history.

rules.problem: Provisional figures change as records arrive
rules.rule: Final figures replace provisional ones. Among provisional releases, the newest wins. Provisional points are drawn hollow.

rules.problem: A report is re-issued at the same web address
rules.rule: Each version is stored separately by its fingerprint and treated as its own release.
It becomes a new indicator, and charts do not draw a line across the change.
Kept as separate series. They are never mixed in one chart line.

rules.problem: Counts with and without infant deaths
rules.rule: Kept as separate series, because DOH reports publish both.
Shown as their own series, never as annual totals.
Values DOH suppressed stay suppressed. They are shown as gaps, not zeros.
